name: SCAMPS, Sophie

headline.note: Official and professional sources establish hospital and emergency medicine, general practice and a South Western Sydney health-promotion role, but exact appointments, employers, hours, leave and overlaps remain incomplete. Study, athletics without an established employment relationship, nonprofit work, candidacy and elected office are excluded. No public or private full-time years are inferred from year-only ranges or medical titles.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen Parliamentary Handbook calls Scamps a professional middle-distance athlete. Her member biography and AMA profile record Australian representation, a World Junior gold medal and Olympic qualification, while World Athletics records results from 1986 through 2001. The sources do not establish continuous paid employment, an employing entity, salary, hours or sponsorship terms across that interval.
career_spells.counting_note: Sporting participation is visible but excluded because substantive paid employment and employer control are not established.

career_spells.evidence_note: Scamps and Parliament identify medical study at the University of Sydney, and the AMA records graduation in 1995. The commencement date, study load and overlap with athletics are not published in the cited sources.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Mona Vale Hospital and unidentified earlier hospital services
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen occupation record gives hospital and emergency medicine from 1995 to 2000. Scamps identifies Mona Vale Hospital, and the archived professional profile reproduced by Healthengine describes several years in emergency medicine. Other facilities, transfers, appointment dates, payroll entities, hours, leave and breaks are unresolved; historical-profile leads mentioning Canberra and Royal North Shore require primary confirmation.
career_spells.counting_note: Public hospital work is supported, but year-only boundaries, unresolved appointments and missing full-time evidence prevent an exact duration calculation.

career_spells.employer: Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland, University of Oxford and University of New South Wales
career_spells.role: Postgraduate student; Masters with Honours, Master of Science and Master of Public Health
career_spells.evidence_note: Parliament and Scamps list postgraduate qualifications from Ireland, Oxford and UNSW, and the AMA says the Irish and Oxford study followed her 1995 graduation. Exact institutions or awards differ in the secondary summaries, and dates, loads and overlap with medical work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen occupation record gives general practice from 2010 to 2021. Member, AMA and ABC profiles identify Narrabeen practice, and the ABC says she practised there until November 2021. The practice's archived profile identifies her as a practitioner. Exact start and cessation days, employment or contractor status, hours, leave and overlap with health-promotion work are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Private general practice is supported, but employment status, hours, exact boundaries and overlap are insufficient for a full-time duration calculation.

career_spells.employer: South Western Sydney Local Health District
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen Parliamentary Handbook records health promotion in the 'Southwest Sydney Local Health District' from 2011. NSW Health identifies the official entity as South Western Sydney Local Health District and records that it was established on 1 January 2011. No located source gives Scamps's title, appointment type, payroll entity, end date, hours, leave or relationship to her overlapping Narrabeen general practice.
career_spells.counting_note: The government-controlled health district and start year are supported, but the nature, duration and workload of the role are unresolved, so no public full-time duration is counted.

career_spells.evidence_note: Scamps says she founded the community-led nonprofit in 2019, and the AMA described it as an NGO in March 2022. Incorporation, appointment and cessation dates, remuneration, hours and continued involvement after election are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Nonprofit founding and governance are excluded absent evidence of substantive paid employment.

career_spells.evidence_note: The AMA records that Scamps announced her independent candidacy in December 2021, and election sources establish her election on 21 May 2022. The precise announcement day, campaign remuneration, workload and any overlap with medical or nonprofit work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Independent candidacy and campaigning are excluded from employment totals.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Mackellar
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster, current Parliament listing and ABC election record establish House service from the 21 May 2022 election.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded under the codebook.

research_notes: Obtain appointment and payroll records for hospital and emergency-medicine work from 1995 to 2000, confirming or rejecting historical-profile leads for Canberra and Royal North Shore and separating those from the supported Mona Vale placement with exact dates, hours, leave and breaks.

Obtain Narrabeen Family Medical Practice records for the exact 2010–November 2021 interval, employment or contractor status, substantive hours, leave and cessation; resolve the 2000–2010 employment gap and postgraduate-study overlaps.

Clarify the South Western Sydney Local Health District health-promotion role recorded from 2011: title, business unit, appointment type, payroll entity, end date, hours, leave and overlap with Narrabeen general practice.

Determine whether athletics or sponsorship constituted paid substantive employment, and obtain Our Blue Dot incorporation, governance, remuneration and workload records. Resolve campaign remuneration and overlap from December 2021 to election.
